rites.name: Thernen
rites.text: Thernen is a concept in Serarnum, a principle of binding and passage that the Courts of the Holy Age used to judge which doors between worlds may open. Its power is measured in the tempering of flame and the weight of oaths sworn before the council.

rites.name: Mianiel
rites.text: Mianiel is a concept of Serarnum in the Seeding, the age when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath it. It is not a being but a notion that the sleeping forces can be woken by a single careful hand, and the Record keeps it as a warning rather than a deed.

rites.name: Tenlanraoma
rites.text: Tenlanraoma is the concept of the Shard-Pact, the oath sworn among the broken worlds of Serarnum after the Fall and the Sundering. It is remembered as the bond that kept the scattered Shards from tearing apart again.

rites.name: Drouggornok
rites.text: Drouggornok is the concept of the Fall in Serarnum, the moment the old bonds between worlds gave way and the Shards scattered. It is remembered as the force that forced the Pact to be sworn among the surviving peoples of the Sundering.

rites.name: Ashishora
rites.text: Ashishora is the concept of a seed-root that binds the branching futures of Serarnum into a single shelved thread during the age of the first sovereign. It is said to hold the grove-kingdoms steady whenever the Library's outcomes begin to fray.

rites.name: Vorothar
rites.text: Vorothar is a concept born in the Three Futures of Serarnum, a force that gathers every branching ending into a single shelved refrain. Its presence is felt most during the Age of Sundering, when the landfall of broken bonds made the Library's shelves tremble.
